string.markdown:

token.markdown:
**token**

Built-in RELAX NG datatype. Normalizes whitespace before comparison (leading/trailing stripped, internal collapsed to single space).

See [RELAX NG Spec](https://relaxng.org/spec-20011203.html#data-pattern)
